skip.crs: RegCM4-3 (SEA-22): the grid mapping (units None, no long name), not a variable
skip.heightv: WRF341E (EUR-44): a height coordinate (height, m), not a variable
skip.soil_bounds: RegCM4-3 (SEA-22): the bounds of the soil layers (depth, m), a coordinate
skip.soil_layer: RegCM4-3 (SEA-22): the depth of the soil layers (depth, m), a coordinate

cdnctop.note: ALADIN63: Cloud Droplet Number Concentration At Cloud Top (m-3), the CMIP6 cldncl

cltc100.note: ALADIN63: Convective Cloud Fraction (convective_cloud_area_fraction, %); the meaning of the suffix 100 is not documented (presumably the percentage)

mross.note: WRF341I: Subsurface runoff (kg m-2 s-1), the CMIP6 mrrob; the same model publishes mrro and mrros

sst.note: WRF341I, WRF360J/K/L: sea surface temperature (K), resolved as the CMIP5 tos (in K)

tds.note: COSMO-crCLIM-v1-1: 2m Dew Point Temperature (K), the CMIP6 tdps

aclwdnt.long_name: Accumulated Downwelling Longwave Flux at Top
aclwdnt.note: WRF341I: accumulated_downwelling_lw_flux_at_top in the metadata, not a CF standard name

alb.note: WRF341I, WRF360J/K/L: no units in most of the metadata

apet.note: WRF360J/K (NARCliM): Kg m-2 in the metadata

hufs.long_name: Upward Moisture Flux at the Surface

icod.note: ALADIN63: ice_cloud_optical_depth in the metadata; CF has no optical thickness due to cloud ice

mrsosat.note: RACMO22E/T (fx): CF has the soil moisture at saturation only as a volume fraction

mrsowp.note: RACMO22E/T (fx): CF has the soil moisture at the wilting point only as a volume fraction

pr-bc.note: WRF360J/K (NARCliM): the metadata do not mention the bias correction; according to the NARCliM documentation (Technical Note 3) a quantile mapping, details not verified

pr-fl.note: WRF360J/K (NARCliM): the meaning of the suffix fl is not documented; the metadata are those of pr (precipitation_flux, Precipitation), published with pr and pr-bc

prls.note: WRF341I: large_scale_precipitation_amount and Kg m-2 s-1 in the metadata, a flux by its units

rluscs.note: ALADIN63: not in the CMOR tables

sfcWindmaxmax.long_name: Maximum Daily Maximum Near-Surface Wind Speed
sfcWindmaxmax.note: WRF360J/K/L (NARCliM): the monthly or seasonal maximum of the daily maximum (Monthly/Seasonal Maximum Daily Maximum Near-Surface Wind Speed), published with sfcWindmax

snownc.note: WRF341I: accumulated_total_grid_scale_snow_and_ice in the metadata (the WRF SNOWNC); the CF standard name is an educated guess (grid-scale, i.e. large-scale, snowfall as liquid water equivalent thickness, also including ice and graupel)

tasmax-bc.long_name: Bias-Corrected Daily Maximum Near-Surface Air Temperature

tasmin-bc.long_name: Bias-Corrected Daily Minimum Near-Surface Air Temperature

tasmaxts.long_name: Daily Maximum Near-Surface Air Temperature, Alternative Computation
tasmaxts.note: WRF341I: the metadata are those of tasmax, also published, but the time axis is shifted by one day (e.g. 1949-12-31 to 2100-12-30 instead of 1950-01-01 to 2100-12-31): presumably the daily maximum over another daily window or sampling of the time series (ts); not documented

tasmints.long_name: Daily Minimum Near-Surface Air Temperature, Alternative Computation

tsmax.note: WRF341I: the daily maximum of the surface (skin) temperature ts, not of the near-surface air temperature (tasmax)

tsmin.note: WRF341I: the daily minimum of the surface (skin) temperature ts, not of the near-surface air temperature (tasmin)

ustar.note: WRF341I: frictional_velocity_in_similarity_theory in the metadata, not a CF standard name
